pages.text: After awakening, toggle Prototype mode (default B). Approach a cow, sheep or common infected. Face it, grab (E) and use to consume; attack throws a held creature. Open Upgrades (U) and spend your first evolution points.

Check reach and line of sight. Ordinary targets with under 50 base max health can usually be grabbed immediately; tougher prey generally need to be at 15% health. Mature hosts and bosses have special rules. Switch back to normal mode for tools, chests and books. A lethal hit kills targets with 50 or fewer base HP outright.
